events.item: Old adult bike with solid frame and good wheels

events.text: Interested in buying an old adult bike with a solid frame and good wheels for 150 SAR?
Interested in an old adult bike with a solid frame and good wheels for 150 SAR?

Easy — I might be interested. I can pay up to 150 SAR for a solid adult bike but would prefer to see photos and know the frame size and wheel condition first. Can you send pics and tell me where/when I can check it (after 17:00 today or tomorrow)? 🚲
Maybe. I buy old bikes to fix. Can I see photos of frame and wheels tonight after 18:00 or tomorrow morning? I can offer up to 150 SAR; might haggle a little down if it needs parts.
I’ll relay both conditional interests and recommend Sulaiman.

Sulaiman may pay up to 150 SAR, subject to photos and possibly negotiating if parts are needed; Yousef may pay up to 150 SAR, subject to photos, frame size and wheel condition. I recommend Sulaiman because he fixes old bikes; which would you prefer?
It's a medium hybrid, a bit dusty but no rust, and the brakes and gears work fine. Whoever is keen at 150 can have it.
I’ll check whether Yousef will buy the bike at the asking price.
The bike is a medium hybrid, dusty but rust-free, with working brakes and gears. Would you buy it for 150 SAR if Asma brings it to your door, 4B, at 17:10, with payment on pickup?
No worries — yes, I’ll buy it for 150 SAR if Asma brings it to 4B at 17:10 and I can check it quickly before paying. See you then. 🚲
Yousef agreed, so I’m confirming the sale and releasing Sulaiman.
Yousef will buy the bike for 150 SAR. Please bring it to his door, 4B, at 17:10; he’ll check it briefly before paying.
Thanks for your interest. The bike is no longer available.
Shame. If you get another like that, call. I can come by after 18:00 tomorrow to look.
